0.heading: Overview
refs: Jer 13:1 , By the type of a linen girdle, hidden at Euphrates, God prefigures the destruction of his people
Jer 13:12 , Under the parable of the bottles filled with wine he foretells their drunkenness in misery
Jer 13:15 , He exhorts to prevent their future judgments
Jer 13:22 , He shews their abominations are the cause thereof.
